setup.notConfigured: Supabase isn't connected yet, so you can look around but not log in. See README.md, step "Connect the app".
setup.profileMissing: We couldn't find your profile. If you're setting things up, check that the SQL migration was run in Supabase.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: One more step today. Rocco saved your spot.
login.resent: Sent! Check your inbox (and the spam folder, just in case).

signup.title: Let's start
signup.subtitle: Small steps, one at a time. Rocco will walk with you.
signup.acceptBefore: I have read and accept the
signup.checkText: We've sent a link to {email}. Tap it to confirm your email and you're in.
signup.checkSpam: Nothing there? Have a look in the spam folder too.

links.expired: That link has expired or was already used. No problem: you can ask for a new one.

forgot.title: New password
forgot.text: It happens to everyone. Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If there's an account with that email, the link is on its way. Check your inbox.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.mismatch: The two passwords are different. Try once more.

welcome.title: Hi, I'm Rocco
welcome.text: I'm a stubborn mountain goat. Sometimes I trip, I patch myself up, and I keep climbing.
welcome.text2: Here we build habits a few steps at a time. No pressure, no guilt. Just the next step.

today.placeholder: Your habits for today will live here very soon.

habits.title: Habits
habits.empty: This is where your goals and habits will grow. Start with a goal: something you care about.
habits.recommendation: Start with up to {count} new habits. Few at a time actually stick.
habits.pausedHint: Paused habits rest here, with all their history and materials. They'll be waiting for you.

dreams.title: Dreams
dreams.text: Rocco is still dreaming this section up. Coming soon.

you.title: You
you.exportText: Download a copy of everything you've saved in Goatstep.
you.deleteText: This deletes your account, your habits, your history and all your files. It can't be undone.
you.deleteCheckbox: I understand that everything will be deleted for good.

legal.draft: This page is being written and will be ready before Goatstep is publicly available.

errors.invalidCredentials: Email or password don't match. Try again.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Your email isn't confirmed yet. Check your inbox for our link.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts in a short time. Take a breath and try again in a few minutes.
errors.weakPassword: Almost there! Your password still needs a few things: check the list, each rule gets a tick when it's done.
errors.passwordRejected: The server didn't accept this password. Please try a different one that follows all the rules in the list.
errors.passwordLeaked: This password has appeared in a data leak on another website, so it isn't safe. Please choose a different one.
errors.samePassword: That's the same as your old password. Choose a new one.
errors.linkExpired: That link has expired. You can ask for a new one.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
errors.exportFailed: We couldn't prepare your file. Please try again in a moment.
errors.deleteFailed: We couldn't delete your account. Nothing was lost: please try again in a moment.

heavy.week: Your flexible habits add up to about {hours} hours a week.
heavy.suggestion: Which ones matter most? Mark them as essential, the rest can be bonus and wait without guilt.

essentials.title: That's a lot of new things
essentials.text: That's a lot of new things at once. Which ones matter most every day? Mark them as essential, the rest can wait without guilt.

priority.essentialHint: Every day it is planned, shown first.
priority.bonusHint: Fine to skip at the beginning. It'll wait for you.

kind.already_mineHint: Something you already do and just want to keep an eye on.

frequency.weeklyHint: Any days you like, e.g. "train 3–5 times a week".
frequency.rangeHint: Choose the same number twice for an exact target, or a range to keep it flexible.

habitEditor.missing: We can't find this habit. It may have been deleted.
habitEditor.pausedNotice: This habit is paused: it rests, with all its history kept.
habitEditor.name: Name
habitEditor.minutesHint: Roughly how long it takes. It helps Rocco notice when a day gets too full.
habitEditor.whyPlaceholder: Why does this matter to you?
habitEditor.minimalHint: The small version for hard days. It still counts.
habitEditor.pauseHint: It disappears from Today but keeps all its history. Resume it whenever you like.
habitEditor.graduateHint: Moves it to "Already mine": it has become yours.
habitEditor.deleteText: Deleting removes this habit for good. If you just need a break, pausing keeps everything.
habitEditor.colorFromGoal: The colour comes from the goal.

goalEditor.missing: We can't find this goal. It may have been deleted.
goalEditor.name: Goal
goalEditor.deleteText: The goal is deleted, its habits stay (you'll find them under "Other habits").

onboarding.routinesText: Do you already have routines you want to keep an eye on? Add them with their goal and how often. They never count as "new".
onboarding.goalTitle: What would you like to work on?
onboarding.goalText: Add your first new habits. For each one, pick a goal: one of yours, an idea, or a new one.
onboarding.habitsLater: You can add your why, a minimal version and an icon later, in each habit.
